Proposition
[Hessian of $r$ for a rotationally symmetric metric]

Source: petersen:page-0136, petersen:page-0137 On $g=dr^2+g_r$, $g_r=\rho ^2(r)ds_{n-1}^2$, on $(a,b)\times S^{n-1}$, since $ds_{n-1}^2$ does not depend on $r$, \[ \mathrm{Hess}\, r=\frac{\partial _r\rho }{\rho }\, g_r. \]
Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch4-hess-r-rotsym \sketch As in subsection 2.1, only the warping factor changes under radial flow. Consequently

\[ 2\operatorname {Hess}r=L_{\partial _r}g_r =2\rho \dot\rho \, ds_{n-1}^2 =2\frac{\dot\rho }{\rho }g_r. \]

□
